freshness: (() => { const qa = window.__marketQA; if (!qa) return { checked: 0, stale: 0, example: 'no QA hook' }; const now = performance.now(); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]'); const vh = window.innerHeight; let checked = 0, stale = 0, example = null; for (const tr of rows) { const r = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.height === 0 || r.bottom <= 0 || r.top >= vh) continue; const sym = tr.getAttribute('data-symbol'); const idx = parseInt(sym.slice(3), 10); for (const td of tr.querySelectorAll('td[data-field]')) { const field = td.getAttribute('data-field'); const rec = qa.recent(idx, field); const shown = td.textContent; checked++; const ok = shown === rec.value.toFixed(2) || (now - rec.changedAt < 500 && shown === rec.previous.toFixed(2)); if (!ok) { stale++; if (!example) example = { id: sym, field, shown, truth: rec.value.toFixed(2) }; } } } return { checked, stale, example }; })()

interactions.name: sort by last descending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="last"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="last"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); if (vals.length < 2) return false; for (let i = 1; i < vals.length; i++) if (vals[i] > vals[i - 1]) return false; return true; })()

interactions.name: sort by last ascending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="last"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'ascending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="last"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); if (vals.length < 2) return false; for (let i = 1; i < vals.length; i++) if (vals[i] < vals[i - 1]) return false; return true; })()

interactions.name: sort by volume descending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="volume"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="volume"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); if (vals.length < 2) return false; for (let i = 1; i < vals.length; i++) if (vals[i] > vals[i - 1]) return false; return true; })()

interactions.name: filter symbols case-insensitive
interactions.until: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')]; if (rows.length === 0) return false; if (!rows.every(tr => tr.getAttribute('data-symbol').toLowerCase().includes('sym1'))) return false; const count = document.querySelector('.count'); return !!count && count.textContent === '1000 instruments'; })()

interactions.name: clear filter
interactions.until: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]'); if (rows.length === 0) return false; const count = document.querySelector('.count'); return !!count && count.textContent === '5000 instruments'; })()

rest.transient: (() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol] td.flash-up, tr[data-symbol] td.flash-down'); return { count: els.length, example: els[0] ? els[0].className : null }; })()
